summary: Frontend-only mobile verification completed for CycleSense at 390x844. Dashboard, session persistence, timeline modal, insights controls, settings controls, web export fallback, and overflow checks passed.
action_items: Add data-testid/testID attributes to interactive controls and critical informational elements to improve stable automated coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Interactive elements currently rely on visible text/accessibility roles rather than explicit testID attributes, contrary to the requested mobile testing convention.
The web CSV export intentionally returns an unavailable/share-sheet fallback; this is expected capability-aware behavior, not a crash.
seed_data_creation: Created one local open session through the dashboard CTA for persistence and modal verification; no backend/seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview verified at 390x844. A first script interruption was caused by an invalid test helper await after the session modal had already passed; the corrected downstream run passed. No red boundary, horizontal overflow, or console error was observed.
rca_of_issue: No application issue reproduced. Session creation persisted locally and reappeared on Timeline navigation; web export correctly displayed its Android share-sheet capability fallback.
